I recently sent my people into the city to check several locations where supplies might still remain, but they weren't able to reach them. You, however... I believe you're capable of handling this task. Head downtown and search several locations: pharmacies, the vet clinic, and the workplace of a radiologist. There may still be something left there. Bring whatever you find back to me, and I'll purchase it from you.
